explication: Moby is a modular container-engine toolkit: an SDK or HTTP caller submits container, image, build, network, or Swarm operations; routers dispatch them to daemon services, which manage images, runtimes, storage, networking, and cluster tasks before returning API results. The graph emphasizes sampled runtime paths and README-documented capabilities. Several route backends and build integrations were only partially sampled, so uncertain internal calls are omitted or shown only where source supports them.
